name: design-canvas
description: Explore project and one-off designs on a persistent canvas with labeled variations like 1a and 1b, pinned annotations, and revision history.

interface.longDescription: Start a one-off design board or load a local project. Compare labeled variations, pin annotations, and iterate on an exact rendering while keeping its revision history. Local storage; no API key needed.
defaultPrompt: Load my project into Design Canvas.
